name: Compute Cluster S12: Datetime Traps (diff order, day_of_week ISO)
description: Tests: datetime_diff argument order (LATER first for positive), day_of_week 0=Monday/6=Sunday ISO convention, datetime_extract components.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S12: Datetime Traps
# Tests: datetime_diff sign, day_of_week convention, datetime_extract
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === DATETIME_DIFF: LATER timestamp first for positive result ===
ts = index()
ts_prev = ts >> 1

# CORRECT: later - earlier = positive
gap_days = datetime_diff(unit=TimeDiffUnit.days)(ts, ts_prev)

# === DAY OF WEEK: 0=Monday, 6=Sunday (ISO) ===
dow = day_of_week(index())
is_monday = dow == 0
is_friday = dow == 4

# Monday effect: compare Monday vs Friday returns
ret = returns(close)
mon_ret = where(is_monday, ret)
fri_ret = where(is_friday, ret)

# === DATETIME_EXTRACT: month, hour, etc. ===
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(index())

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Gap Between Bars (days)',
    category='Datetime',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Gap (days)', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=gap_days)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.CalendarIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Return', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Monday Returns'
    )
)(mon_ret, is_monday)

cards(
    category='Datetime',
    layout=CardLayout(title='Day-of-Week Stats', cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Mon Avg Return', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title='Fri Avg Return', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4)
    ])
)(mon_ret, fri_ret)
